fixed_body.note: full mill body + stationary hub/face on shared 384x384 plane; 7928 blade-occlusion px repaired via Telea inpaint constrained to blade footprints; blade-root stubs read as fixed mounting collar

movable_rotor.note: 4 blades: lattice frames (rails/crossbars/bolts) + sail cloth; transparent hub opening r<40 around pivot; no body/roof/flag pixels

pivots.json.note: notes-based part/pivot contract: shared plane, layer order, offsets, hub centre, rotor pivot, reconstruction

qc.containment: pass (content bbox respects >=15px padding on shared 384x384 plane)
qc.geometry_scale: pass (same camera/scale as source; hub centre (209,176) verified by overlay; rotation pivot = hub centre)
qc.identity: pass (all non-occluded pixels are source pixels; hub face, roof, flag, shield, door, dust puffs untouched; no new design/mood/face)
qc.pivot: pass (35-degree runtime-style rotation test: blades orbit hub cleanly, tower/base/hub-face static)
qc.reconstruction_composite: pass (movable_rotor over fixed_body reproduces upscaled reference: mean abs diff 0.019 over visible pixels; residual = 1-2px feather seams at separation boundaries; RGB-only diffs in fully-transparent pixels ignored)
qc.resolution: pass (384x384 RGBA masters, 2x Lanczos upscale of 192x192 source)
qc.separation: pass (4/4 blades fully on rotor incl. frames/bolts; hub face+ring, tower, roof, flag on body; no body chunks in rotor)

raw_generation.note: REJECTED and excluded from deliverables: model redrew the whole mill (new proportions, 3D-ish style, altered face) instead of inpainting only the magenta-marked occlusions; kept for audit only

repair_method: classical_inpaint (OpenCV Telea r=6 on edge-diffused fill, 2px feathered seam) after 1 rejected generative edit pass; repair mask strictly inside rotor footprint (rotor AND closed-body-silhouette AND touching body) so no background pixels were painted
